complex_probe.environment: flutter_test / Debug JIT; host wall time, CPU layout and paint recording; not device FrameTiming or GPU raster
complex_probe.factory_note: Only constructs the root Widget description. Descendant Widget creation, Element mounting, build/layout/paint and teardown are included in full_pump_us.
complex_probe.instrumentation_note: row_root and dynamic_leaf_root measure their own probe callbacks, not every relayout/repaint boundary below them. Zero root callbacks do not mean zero subtree work. Root and leaf durations can overlap and must not be summed.
complex_probe.identity_note: root_widget_descriptions_created counts explicit root factories only. widget_descriptions_changed counts replaced immutable descriptions on retained Elements; it does not count Element mounting or total descendant Widget constructors.

idle_calibration.interpretation: Diagnostic tester/framework baseline only; do not subtract it from update or mount timings to claim net cost.
